name: Ember-1
title: Ember-1: price, context window and specs
answer: Ember-1 is a model from Fireworks, first listed on 2026-09-24. It is the only version of its line in the catalog so far. It takes text and image in and returns text, with a context window of 1.0 million tokens and up to 943K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
